name: TimeField
description: A time of day, typed hour by minute: opening hours, a delivery slot.

label.description: The field's name, drawn above it.

isLabelHidden.description: Hides the label from sight; it still names the field for a screen reader.

errorMessage.description: Set means invalid: the field shows this message under it.

name.description: Names the value inside a Form block.

variant.description: secondary is for a field on a grey surface.

fullWidth.description: false takes the natural field width token.

defaultValue.description: Starts at this time; the merchant changes it. A time of day, ISO 8601: 14:30, or 14:30:15 at seconds.

value.description: Pinned: shows exactly what the server sent until the next tree. A time of day, ISO 8601: 14:30, or 14:30:15 at seconds.

minValue.description: The earliest time. A time of day, ISO 8601: 14:30, or 14:30:15 at seconds.

maxValue.description: The latest time. A time of day, ISO 8601: 14:30, or 14:30:15 at seconds.

onChange.description: A time of day, ISO 8601: 14:30, or 14:30:15 at seconds.
